metadata.title: Studio Glamour Portrait with Industrial Lighting
useCases: Vintage soul or disco album covers

retrievalProfile.description: A high-fashion studio portrait featuring a central subject in elegant evening wear contrasted against visible industrial lighting equipment and a neutral seamless backdrop.
triggerTerms: glamour studio portrait with boom light
vintage fashion photography with industrial equipment
satin dress and fur in studio setting

recipe.visualDefinition: A sophisticated studio composition where a female subject in a pink satin gown and white fur is positioned centrally under a large, visible industrial boom light, set against a dark, moody seamless background that transitions to a light floor.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically under the industrial light fixture
Contrast between the soft textures of satin/fur and the hard metal of the lighting rig
Dark, vignetted background framing the brightly lit central figure
Horizontal boom arm cutting across the upper-left quadrant
coreInvariants: Visible studio lighting equipment as a compositional element
High-contrast lighting focusing on the subject's face and torso
Neutral, seamless studio backdrop with visible floor transition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, full-body scale, standing on a dark platform.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white umbrella/reflector of the boom light directly above the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top light, follows the vertical line down to the subject's face, then down the length of the satin dress to the fur at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space in the upper corners and sides, creating a spotlight effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the subject and the dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Single saturated pastel for the garment

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Fluid, connected script with consistent slant
Middle text: Wide, all-caps sans-serif with high tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: Sans-serif characters with extremely short x-height relative to width
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between elegant, personal script and rigid, modern architectural sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal boom arm as a divider

preserve: Script style for the top name
Wide tracking for the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn feel of the top text
Matches the wide, geometric feel of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a woman in a pink satin dress and white fur coat, standing under a large industrial boom light with a white umbrella reflector. The background should be a dark, moody seamless studio backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin, white cursive name at the top center. Add a very small, wide-tracked all-caps sans-serif title to the right of the subject's head.

verificationChecks: Is the boom light visible and positioned above the subject?
Is the dress satin and the coat fur-textured?
Is the top text a thin script?
Is the secondary text wide-tracked and tiny?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific celebrity likenesses
Do not use existing brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lighting rig looks functional and industrial
Check that the satin dress has realistic highlights
Verify the text is legible but unobtrusive
Confirm the central vertical alignment of light and subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Glamour + Industrial Equipment + High Contrast Chiaroscuro
